description:
FOX 12 Oregon keeps you connected to what’s happening across Oregon and Southwest Washington … and why it matters.

From breaking news and in-depth local reporting to First Alert Weather, sports and the stories shaping our communities, FOX 12 is your source for trusted, local coverage.

Start your day with Good Day Oregon, 4:30a to 11a, stay ahead of changing conditions with the FOX 12 First Alert Weather team, and follow the teams and athletes shaping our region with Rose City SportsNet.

Subscribe to FOX 12 Oregon on YouTube for the latest local news, weather, sports, investigations, and stories from across the Pacific Northwest.

Want more FOX 12?

Stream “FOX 12 Oregon” and watch live newscasts and more on the FOX 12 app, available on your favorite streaming devices.
